test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8d6b975b02b79e39db18438a89df5152d07846dc3790028900ab704c6065019.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is

Step (1): S changes to its mirror image in every step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7dfe6ad7c997ef1aba1e23ab5e473039d1fb3a560af7c3d8baad173968b8f53.png] 

Then options 2 and 3 will be eliminated.

**Two type of movements are followed.**

**Step (2):** The elements which are sitting** in the corner, moving clockwise direction**. The elements are sitting on the** side, moving anticlockwise direction.** This movement happens at **every alternative time.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0664bd7f7e82a7a355915dfd915dd5f81b32569b6f4f7dd9f5160ed74a5662e4.png] 

**Step (3):** Left side elements are moving **anti-clockwise direction.** The right side elements are moving** clockwise direction.** The elements which are placed in the **middle interchange their position.** This movement happens at every **alternative time.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b541c6f91471c4de7339e8e6ffc728ef1b477f3fea2e69ed6ceaca565bdc4243.png] 

**Step (4):** As same as Step (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca47762e45fe53479458c76bef139cbb0bbdac710c8e4aec2f1059aa041847d3.png] 

Step (5): As same as Step (2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13c0f8930d13c018d6145354062ed7a72c231710ac5a205867587992010750f1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "option 1".**
